mainTopic: The end of רבי יוחנן's קל וחומר about רבי יוסי, and רב's proofs that five תנאים hold אין שני עושה שלישי בחולין
overview: The amud opens at the end of רבי יוחנן's קל וחומר. He wonders why רבי יוסי did not prove a רביעי in קודש from the case of a טבול יום. The גמרא blocks one possible answer. A טבול יום was once an אב הטומאה, but so was a מחוסר כיפורים, and רבי יוסי learned from him anyway. Then רב makes a new claim. Five תנאים, רבי מאיר, רבי יוסי, רבי יהושע, רבי אלעזר and רבי אליעזר, all hold that a שני does not make a שלישי in חולין. The גמרא proves this for each one in turn. For רבי מאיר, the proof is a משנה about someone who needs immersion only מדברי סופרים. For רבי יוסי, the proof is where his own קל וחומר stops. For רבי יהושע, it is a משנה that allows a שלישי only in חולין kept at the purity of תרומה. For רבי אלעזר, it is his ladder of levels in קודש, תרומה and חולין. The amud ends by quoting רבי אליעזר's משנה about taking חלה from pure dough for impure dough, and the proof from it comes on the next amud.

steps.title: The end of the קל וחומר: a שלישי should make a רביעי in קודש
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן finishes his קל וחומר. If a טבול יום, who is allowed to touch חולין, still causes a chain that reaches קודש, then surely a שלישי that came from a שני should make a רביעי in קודש. After all, the שני itself is impure even for חולין.
steps.simpleTranslation: A third-degree item that got its impurity from a second-degree item, where the second-degree item itself is impure even for ordinary food: isn't it logical that it makes a fourth degree in sacred food?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is finishing רבי יוחנן's קל וחומר, which began just before this section. Its point is that רבי יוסי could have proven a רביעי in קודש this way, so why didn't he?
steps.deeperAnalysis: The קל וחומר compares a weak source with a stronger one. A טבול יום is weak, since he does not make חולין impure, yet he still starts a chain in קודש. A שני is stronger, since it does make חולין impure. So a שלישי that came from a שני should surely make a רביעי in קודש. The challenge is aimed at רבי יוסי for not using this simpler proof.

keyTerms.meaning: Third-degree impurity
Fourth-degree impurity, which exists only for קודש
Ordinary, non-sacred food
Sacrificial, sacred food
"Isn't it logical?": the closing words of a קל וחומר

steps.confusionAlert: This line is not the start of the argument. The first half of the קל וחומר, about the טבול יום, came right before this section. Here you are only seeing its second half.

phrases.english: A third-degree item that came about because of a second-degree item,
where the second-degree item itself is forbidden even with ordinary food,
phrases.notes: "Forbidden" here means it makes ordinary food impure. That is exactly what a טבול יום does not do.

phrases.english: isn't it logical that it makes a fourth degree in sacred food?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes רבי יוחנן's קל וחומר, which began on the previous page
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוסי's choice not to prove a רביעי בקודש from a טבול יום
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A simple קל וחומר from the weaker case of a טבול יום would prove that a שלישי makes a רביעי in קודש, so why did רבי יוסי not use it?

steps.title: Blocking the escape: the 'he was once an אב הטומאה' objection doesn't work
steps.stepSummary: Someone might say רבי יוסי skipped the קל וחומר because it can be knocked down: a טבול יום was once an אב הטומאה. The גמרא answers that רבי יוסי himself learned from מחוסר כיפורים, who was also once an אב הטומאה. He did not treat that as a problem there.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you say it is because the argument can be refuted, 'what about a טבול יום, who was a primary source of impurity?', that can't be. רבי יוסי brought his proof from a מחוסר כיפורים and did not refute it that way!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא imagines a defense of רבי יוסי and then knocks it down. This keeps רבי יוחנן's puzzle alive.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A פירכא would say that a טבול יום is special because before immersing he was an אב הטומאה. So the קל וחומר would not carry over to a plain שלישי. But a מחוסר כיפורים was also an אב הטומאה before immersing, and רבי יוסי happily learned from him. So that difference clearly did not bother רבי יוסי. The puzzle stands: he must simply disagree with the source about the טבול יום.

keyTerms.meaning: "And if you would say": introduces a possible objection the גמרא will reject
To refute, to knock down an argument (a פירכא)
Someone who immersed today but must wait for nightfall to become fully pure
A primary source of impurity
Someone who immersed and waited for nightfall but has not yet brought his atonement offering

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יוחנן's puzzle survives. The 'he was once an אב הטומאה' difference can't explain רבי יוסי, because he learned from מחוסר כיפורים, who has the same history.

phrases.english: And if you would say it is because one can refute it:

phrases.aramaic: מָה לִטְבוּל יוֹם שֶׁכֵּן אַב הַטּוּמְאָה —
phrases.english: What about a טבול יום, who is a primary source of impurity?
phrases.notes: He means the טבול יום was an אב הטומאה before he immersed.

phrases.english: But he brought it from one lacking atonement,
phrases.notes: "He" is רבי יוסי, who proved a fourth degree in קודש from a מחוסר כיפורים.

phrases.english: and he did not refute it!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Blocks a possible defense of רבי יוסי against the קל וחומר in step 1
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The suggested פירכא that a טבול יום is different because he was once an אב הטומאה
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: רבי יוסי himself learned from מחוסר כיפורים, who was also once an אב הטומאה, so that difference did not matter to him

steps.title: רב: five תנאים hold a שני does not make a שלישי in חולין
steps.stepSummary: רב (reported by רב אסי, or by רבה בן איסי) lists five תנאים who all hold that a שני cannot make a שלישי in חולין.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אסי said in the name of רב, and some say רבה בן איסי said in the name of רב: רבי מאיר, רבי יוסי, רבי יהושע, רבי אלעזר and רבי אליעזר all hold that a second degree does not make a third degree in ordinary food.
steps.whatsHappening: A new topic begins. רב makes a claim about five תנאים, and the גמרא will now prove it for each one in turn.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In חולין the chain of impurity stops at the שני level. Whatever a שני touches stays pure as ordinary food. רב claims this is the shared view of all five תנאים, and this sets up a series of proofs.

keyTerms.meaning: They hold, they are of the opinion
Second-degree impurity

steps.whyThisMatters: It lays out the plan for the rest of the sugya: a proof for each of the five named תנאים.

phrases.english: Rav Asi said that Rav said,

phrases.aramaic: וְאָמְרִי לַהּ אָמַר רַבָּה בֶּן אִיסִי אָמַר רַב:
phrases.english: and some say Rabba ben Isi said that Rav said:

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי מֵאִיר, וְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי, וְרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ,
phrases.english: Rabbi Meir, and Rabbi Yosei, and Rabbi Yehoshua,
and Rabbi Elazar, and Rabbi Eliezer —
all of them hold
that a second degree does not make a third degree in ordinary food.

steps.triggerLanguage: כּוּלְּהוּ סְבִירָא לְהוּ דְּאֵין שֵׁנִי עוֹשֶׂה שְׁלִישִׁי בְּחוּלִּין
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new topic after the discussion of רבי יוסי's view
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי מאיר, רבי יוסי, רבי יהושע, רבי אלעזר and רבי אליעזר, a שני does not make a שלישי in חולין

steps.title: Proof for רבי מאיר from the משנה about rabbinic immersion
steps.stepSummary: The proof for רבי מאיר is a משנה. Someone who needs immersion only מדברי סופרים makes קודש impure and disqualifies תרומה, but he is allowed to touch חולין and מעשר. That is רבי מאיר's view; the חכמים forbid him with מעשר.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי מאיר: as we learned, anyone who needs immersion by rabbinic law makes sacred food impure and disqualifies תרומה, but is permitted with ordinary food and מעשר. These are the words of רבי מאיר. The חכמים forbid him with מעשר.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a משנה to show that רבי מאיר holds a שני does not make a שלישי in חולין.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A person who needs immersion only by rabbinic law has the level of a שני. רבי מאיר says he may touch חולין and even מעשר without making them impure. That means a שני does not create a שלישי in חולין. The חכמים are stricter only about מעשר.

keyTerms.meaning: Literally "coming into water": immersion in a מקוה
By rabbinic law
Disqualifies: makes it impure, but it cannot pass the impurity further
The portion of produce given to a כהן
Here, מעשר שני, the second tithe eaten in ירושלים

steps.confusionAlert: The משנה never says the words 'שני' or 'שלישי'. The proof comes from what it implies: this person is like a שני, and he doesn't make חולין impure.

phrases.english: Rabbi Meir, as we learned in a משנה:

phrases.aramaic: כׇּל הַטָּעוּן בִּיאַת מַיִם מִדִּבְרֵי סוֹפְרִים,
phrases.english: Anyone who requires immersion in water by rabbinic law

phrases.aramaic: מְטַמֵּא אֶת הַקּוֹדֶשׁ, וּפוֹסֵל אֶת הַתְּרוּמָה,
phrases.english: makes sacred food impure, and disqualifies תרומה,
and is permitted with ordinary food and with מעשר,
these are the words of Rabbi Meir.
But the Sages forbid him with מעשר.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins proving רב's list, starting with רבי מאיר
steps.raayaObject: רבי מאיר holds that a שני does not make a שלישי in חולין
steps.raayaSupportSource: משנה in פרה: someone who needs rabbinic immersion is permitted with חולין and מעשר, according to רבי מאיר

steps.title: The proof for רבי יוסי from his own reasoning
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוסי's קל וחומר stops at a רביעי in קודש. If he held that חולין can be a שלישי, every level would move up by one.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוסי: this is what we already said. If he held there is a שלישי in חולין, he should have reached a רביעי in תרומה and a חמישי in קודש.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא proves that רבי יוסי belongs on רב's list. It points back to the קל וחומר we already saw.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each kind of food goes one level further than the kind below it: חולין, then תרומה, then קודש. רבי יוסי derived only a רביעי in קודש, so his chain must start with חולין stopping at שני. If חולין went down to שלישי, his reasoning would have produced a רביעי in תרומה and a חמישי in קודש, and he never says that.

keyTerms.meaning: What we already said (pointing back to an earlier discussion)
Let him bring it, meaning his reasoning should have produced this
A fourth level of impurity
A fifth level of impurity

phrases.english: Rabbi Yosei: that which we already said.
phrases.notes: This points back to רבי יוסי's קל וחומר from earlier, which reached a רביעי in קודש.

phrases.english: For if he held it,
he should have brought a fourth level in תרומה,
and a fifth level in קודש.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to the next תנא in רב's list, after the proof for רבי מאיר.
steps.raayaObject: רבי יוסי holds that a שני does not make a שלישי in חולין
steps.raayaSupportSource: The structure of רבי יוסי's own קל וחומר, which ends at a רביעי in קודש

steps.title: The proof for רבי יהושע from a משנה about eating impure food
steps.stepSummary: A משנה records a dispute between רבי אליעזר and רבי יהושע about the status of a person who eats food at different levels of impurity.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהושע: as we learned in a משנה. רבי אליעזר says: one who eats ראשון food becomes a ראשון, one who eats שני food becomes a שני, and one who eats שלישי food becomes a שלישי. רבי יהושע says: one who eats ראשון or שני food becomes a שני. One who eats שלישי food becomes a שני for קודש, but not a שני for תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a משנה as its source for רבי יהושע. The actual proof becomes clear in the next step, when the גמרא explains what kind of food this case is about.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אליעזר says the eater takes on the same level as the food he ate. רבי יהושע says eating ראשון or שני food makes a person a שני. Eating שלישי food makes him a שני only for קודש, not for תרומה. The key detail is that רבי יהושע talks about someone eating a שלישי at all.

keyTerms.meaning: One who eats
Food at the first level of impurity
Counted as a שני for קודש only

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehoshua: as we learned in a משנה:
Rabbi Eliezer says:
one who eats first-level food becomes first-level,
second-level food makes him second-level, and third-level food makes him third-level.
Rabbi Yehoshua says:

phrases.aramaic: הָאוֹכֵל אוֹכֶל רִאשׁוֹן וְאוֹכֶל שֵׁנִי — שֵׁנִי,
phrases.english: one who eats first-level food or second-level food becomes second-level,
and third-level food makes him second-level for קודש,
but not second-level for תרומה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to the next תנא in רב's list, רבי יהושע.
steps.raayaObject: רבי יהושע holds that a שני does not make a שלישי in חולין
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה in טהרות about one who eats impure food

steps.title: The case is about חולין kept at the purity of תרומה
steps.stepSummary: The eater of a שלישי in the משנה must have eaten חולין that were prepared at the purity level of תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: This is about חולין that were prepared at the purity level of תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains which food רבי יהושע means when he talks about eating a שלישי. This is where the proof for him actually lands.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A person may not eat impure תרומה or קודש, so the שלישי he ate must be חולין. Yet the גמרא says this works only for חולין kept at the purity level of תרומה. That shows that ordinary חולין never become a שלישי, which is exactly the view רב attributed to רבי יהושע.

keyTerms.meaning: Ordinary food that is not holy
Kept at the purity level required for תרומה
Third level of impurity

steps.confusionAlert: Do not read this as saying that חולין in general can be a שלישי. The point is the opposite: only these special חולין, treated like תרומה, can reach שלישי.
steps.whyThisMatters: This one line turns a משנה about eating impure food into a proof that, for רבי יהושע, ordinary חולין stop at שני.

phrases.english: It is about חולין that were prepared
at the purity level of תרומה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains the case in the משנה just quoted. This is what makes it a proof for רבי יהושע.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: One might think רבי יהושע's case of eating a שלישי refers to ordinary חולין.
steps.terutzMaskana: It refers only to חולין kept at the purity level of תרומה. Ordinary חולין have no שלישי.
steps.raayaObject: רבי יהושע holds that a שני does not make a שלישי in חולין
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי יהושע's case of eating a שלישי must be about חולין kept at the purity of תרומה, which implies that ordinary חולין have no שלישי

steps.title: חולין can be raised to the level of תרומה, but not to the level of קודש
steps.stepSummary: From רבי יהושע's words, the גמרא learns that treating חולין at the purity of תרומה counts, but treating them at the purity of קודש does not count in the same way.
steps.simpleTranslation: At the purity level of תרומה, yes. At the purity level of קודש, no.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא draws an inference from the case it just explained. This sets up its conclusion about רבי יהושע in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהושע speaks only of חולין kept like תרומה, which then act like תרומה. From this the גמרא learns that חולין treated at the purity level of קודש are not raised to the status of קודש.

keyTerms.meaning: Yes
No
The purity level required for קודש

steps.whatToRemember: The proof for רבי יוסי comes from where his קל וחומר stops. The proof for רבי יהושע comes from the fact that a שלישי in חולין exists only for חולין kept at the purity of תרומה. Such חולין can be raised to the level of תרומה, but not to the level of קודש.

phrases.english: At the purity level of תרומה, yes,
at the purity level of קודש, no.

steps.triggerLanguage: עַל טׇהֳרַת הַתְּרוּמָה — אִין, עַל טׇהֳרַת הַקּוֹדֶשׁ — לָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws a further inference from the explanation in the previous step.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: חולין can take on the purity status of תרומה, but not the purity status of קודש.

steps.title: So רבי יהושע holds a שני does not make a שלישי in חולין
steps.stepSummary: From the previous analysis, the גמרא concludes that רבי יהושע holds that in ordinary חולין, a שני cannot create a שלישי.
steps.simpleTranslation: So we see that רבי יהושע holds that a שני does not make a שלישי in חולין.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא closes its discussion of רבי יהושע. It states his position in one clear rule.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In Step 7 we learned that only חולין kept at the purity level of תרומה can become a שלישי. So plain חולין stop at שני. That puts רבי יהושע on the list of those who hold אין שני עושה שלישי בחולין, next to רבי מאיר and רבי יוסי.

keyTerms.meaning: So we see / apparently: introduces what we learn from the source
He holds (this opinion)
An item with second-level impurity
An item with third-level impurity
Ordinary food that is not קודש or תרומה

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יהושע joins רבי מאיר and רבי יוסי: in plain חולין, a שני does not make a שלישי.
steps.confusionAlert: This does not mean חולין can never be a שלישי. Step 7 showed that חולין kept at the purity level of תרומה can be. The rule here is only about plain חולין.

phrases.english: So we see that he holds:
phrases.notes: "He" is רבי יהושע from the משנה in the last steps.

phrases.english: A second-level item does not make a third-level item in ordinary food.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: States the final takeaway from the reading of רבי יהושע in Steps 6-8.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: רבי יהושע holds אין שני עושה שלישי בחולין.

steps.title: רבי אלעזר: a ראשון works in all three kinds of food
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא adds רבי אלעזר to the list and quotes his teaching. A first-level item counts the same in קודש, in חולין and in תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אלעזר also holds this. As it was taught: רבי אלעזר says, all three are alike: a first-level item in קודש, in חולין and in תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא names the next תנא who holds this view, רבי אלעזר, and begins quoting his source. This is a setup: the details that prove the point come next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אלעזר first says a ראשון has the same starting status in all three kinds of food. Then he will explain how far its impurity reaches in each one. The proof for our question will come from what he says about חולין.

keyTerms.meaning: All three of them are alike
An item with first-level impurity
Sacred food, such as from קרבנות

phrases.english: Rabbi Elazar (also holds this),
as it was taught: Rabbi Elazar says:
All three of them are alike:
the first-level item in sacred food,
and in ordinary food, and in teruma.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר — דְּתַנְיָא, רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר אוֹמֵר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After finishing with רבי יהושע, the גמרא moves to the next תנא on its list.
steps.raayaObject: That רבי אלעזר holds אין שני עושה שלישי בחולין
steps.raayaSupportSource: A תנאי teaching of רבי אלעזר about a ראשון in קודש, חולין and תרומה

steps.title: How far a ראשון reaches in קודש and in תרומה
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר explains the reach of a ראשון. In קודש it makes two levels that can still pass on impurity, plus one more level that is only unusable. In תרומה it makes one level that passes on impurity, plus one that is only unusable.
steps.simpleTranslation: In קודש, it makes two levels impure and disqualifies one more. In תרומה, it makes one level impure and disqualifies one more.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אלעזר lists, level by level, how far a ראשון's impurity travels in קודש and then in תרומה. This sets up the חולין case, which comes right after this.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In קודש, the ראשון makes a שני and a שלישי that can still pass on impurity, and the רביעי is unusable but passes nothing on. In תרומה, it makes a שני that passes impurity on, and the שלישי is unusable and stops there. Each step down in holiness drops one level, so חולין should stop at שני.

keyTerms.meaning: Makes impure: the item can pass impurity on further
Disqualifies: the item becomes unusable but passes nothing on
The portion of produce given to a כהן
An item with fourth-level impurity, found only in קודש

steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up מטמא and פוסל. מטמא means the next item can keep spreading impurity. פוסל means the next item is ruined but the chain ends there.
steps.whyThisMatters: This pattern (קודש goes furthest, then תרומה) is what lets the גמרא prove that for רבי אלעזר, חולין stop at שני.

phrases.english: it makes two levels impure,
and disqualifies one more, in sacred food;
it makes one level impure,
and disqualifies one more, in teruma;

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues quoting רבי אלעזר's teaching and gives the details behind 'all three are alike.'
steps.raayaObject: That the levels shrink as holiness drops, leading to the חולין rule
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי אלעזר's list of levels for קודש and תרומה

steps.title: In חולין a ראשון reaches only one level
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר finishes his teaching: in חולין, a ראשון makes only one more level unusable, so there is no שלישי in חולין.
steps.simpleTranslation: And in ordinary food, it makes only one level unusable.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes quoting רבי אלעזר. In חולין, a ראשון makes only one more level, and that level is just unusable.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In קודש a ראשון reaches three levels, and in תרומה it reaches two. In חולין it reaches only one: the שני, which is unusable but cannot pass impurity on. So a שני cannot create a שלישי in חולין, which is exactly the point the גמרא is trying to prove.

keyTerms.meaning: Makes something unusable (disqualifies it) without making it able to pass impurity further
Ordinary food that is not holy
An item with first-level impurity
An item with second-level impurity

steps.whatToRemember: Here is the ladder: in קודש there are 3 levels, in תרומה 2, and in חולין only 1. So in חולין nothing goes past a שני.
steps.whyThisMatters: This makes רבי אלעזר a clear support for the view that a שני does not create a שלישי in חולין.

phrases.english: And in ordinary food, it disqualifies one level.
phrases.notes: "It" is the ראשון. The one level it touches becomes a שני, which is unusable but cannot pass impurity on.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the quote of רבי אלעזר that was started in steps 10 and 11.
steps.raayaObject: The claim that in חולין a שני cannot create a שלישי.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The teaching of רבי אלעזר: a ראשון makes only one level unusable in חולין.

steps.title: רבי אליעזר's משנה on taking חלה from pure dough for impure dough
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא adds רבי אליעזר to the list of תנאים and quotes his משנה about taking חלה from pure dough to cover impure dough, using a small linking piece of dough.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אליעזר also holds this, as we learned in a משנה. רבי אליעזר says: חלה may be taken from pure dough to cover impure dough. How? Say there are two batches of dough, one pure and one impure. A person takes enough for חלה from the dough whose חלה has not yet been separated. Then he puts a piece smaller than an egg in the middle, so that he is taking from dough that is joined together.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings another source, a משנה of רבי אליעזר, and lays out its case. This sets up the next move, where the גמרא will show how this case fits the rule that there is no שלישי in חולין.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Normally חלה must be taken from dough that is joined to the dough it covers. Joining the two batches directly would risk the impure dough spreading impurity to the pure dough. So רבי אליעזר links them with a piece smaller than a כביצה, which is too small to pass impurity on. The גמרא explains on the next amud why this case helps its point.

keyTerms.meaning: The portion of dough given to a כהן
A batch of dough
How so? It introduces the details of a case
The size of an egg. Food smaller than this cannot pass impurity on to other food.
Joined together, or close by. Here: dough that touches the dough it covers.

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up רבי אליעזר (with a yud, אֱלִיעֶזֶר) in this step with רבי אלעזר (אֶלְעָזָר) from the step before. They are two different תנאים.

phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer [also holds this], as we learned in a משנה:
Rabbi Eliezer says:

phrases.aramaic: חַלָּה נִיטֶּלֶת מִן הַטְּהוֹרָה עַל הַטְּמֵאָה,
phrases.english: חלה may be taken from pure dough on behalf of impure dough.
How so?

phrases.aramaic: שְׁתֵּי עִיסּוֹת אַחַת טְהוֹרָה וְאַחַת טְמֵאָה,
phrases.english: Two batches of dough, one pure and one impure.
He takes the amount needed for חלה
from the dough whose חלה has not yet been separated,
phrases.notes: This is the pure dough. Its חלה will now count for both batches.

phrases.english: and he places less than an egg-size piece in the middle,
phrases.notes: Food smaller than a כביצה cannot pass impurity on to other food. So it joins the two batches without carrying impurity across.

phrases.english: so as to take from dough that is joined together.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After finishing רבי אלעזר, the גמרא adds the next תנא to its list of sources.
steps.raayaObject: That רבי אליעזר also holds that a שני does not create a שלישי in חולין.
steps.raayaSupportSource: משנה in מסכת חלה: taking חלה from pure dough for impure dough using a piece smaller than a כביצה in the middle.
